question: Where is the Red Panda Winter Carnival celebrated?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Every year the northeastern state of **Sikkim** hosts the **Red Panda Festival.**
 
• The winter occasion features **parades, live music and draws tourists and locals alike.**
 
• It's a cheerful celebration named for **Sikkim's historic state animal.**
 
• It is the **biggest tourism festival** of the state and motives at promoting communal harmony and **'Unity in Diversity'.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d2ea17f2b0b13bb89b7a14b39517283896930019bbbba67a36859ec23ef0d16.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Pushkar Camel Fair (Rajasthan)** is one of the largest in India and the only one of its type in the whole world.​ 
 
• In** Tamil,** the word **"Mattu"** means bull and this day of **Pongal is for celebration of cattle.**
 
• Hornbill Festival is **one of the most popular festivals of Nagaland, celebrated every year from 1st to 10th December**.
